name: reschedule_appointment
description: MUST call immediately after the caller explicitly confirms a fresh replacement slot. Reuse the caller_full_name already established in this conversation; never ask for it again. Copy practitioner_id, branch_id, appointment_type_id, and start_time unchanged from the confirmed search_availability slot. Include appointment_id from list_appointments whenever available. If it is omitted, the backend proceeds only when that exact patient has one upcoming appointment; multiple appointments return an error and require explicit selection. Never report a technical issue unless this tool was actually called and returned ok=false.

appointment_id.description: Exact appointments[].appointment_id UUID from list_appointments. Required when the patient has multiple upcoming appointments; omit only when exactly one exists.

practitioner_id.description: Exact practitioner_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

branch_id.description: Exact branch_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

appointment_type_id.description: Exact appointment_type_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

start_time.description: Exact start_time from the confirmed replacement slot; do not derive it from spoken time.
